text:
alex: FYI, noticed a 3x latency tail on canary after today's merge (PR #3312). Appears during cold starts, lots of compiles.
maria: seeing it in CI too, flamegraphs showing repeated compile time spikes.
perf-bot: alert: compile_storms=128 over last 10m; metric: kernel_compile_queue_latency p95=1.9s
suresh: probable cause: heuristic sensitivity change in runtime-core commit ab12cd34 — autotune threshold lowered, causing aggressive kernel switch and cache invalidation
jen: can you paste the exact commit/change?
charlie: it's this hunk in PR #3312: `heuristic.sensitivity = max(0.1, heuristic.sensitivity - 0.4)` — flipped sign during refactor
alex: ugh. that would cause different kernel choices earlier and evict KV cache entries often
maria: repro script attached: `./tools/repro --model=open-llama-7b --seq=512 --warm=20 --iters=200` shows compile loop
maria: logs:
```
[run] step=42 kernel_choice=GEMM_INT8 compile_start
[compile] jid=0x3f2 compile_time=450ms cache_miss=1
[run] step=43 kernel_choice=GEMM_FUSED compile_start
[compile] jid=0x4a1 compile_time=430ms cache_miss=1
... repeat ...
```
suresh: quick mitigation: set `HEURISTIC_SENSITIVITY=0.9` in runtime config to prefer stable picks until we ship a patch
alex: can we hotfix on canary and run a canary rollback? deploy-bot: started canary rollback for service runtime-canary -> version v2026.03.15-rollback
jen: also seeing increased KV cache churn metrics (kv_evictions p50 up 5x)
charlie: bisect plan: git bisect between tag v2026.03.14 and HEAD, but PR #3312 is the likely culprit
maria: I'll run the bisect + perf harness overnight and upload profile link
perf-bot: perf-harness: upload complete -> https://perf.internal/reports/1940012345
alex: sounds good. if bisect confirms, we should revert PR #3312 and open a follow-up with unit tests for sensitivity bounds
suresh: agreed. I'll draft a revert PR and a safer clamp: `sensitivity = clamp(sensitivity - delta, 0.6, 1.0)` and add telemetry
jen: for transparency, add postmortem note in #eng-runtime once we have bisect results
alex: thanks all — tagging @maria and @suresh to own the rollback and bisect. :thumbsup:
